tool.name: GeneFior Gene Stats
tool.description: Generate gene-level coverage visualisations and read exports
tool.command: ## Reconstruct a results directory from the provided TSV files mkdir -p input_results/raw_outputs && cp '$detection_matrix' input_results/raw_outputs/detection_matrix.tsv && #if $evidence_matrix: cp '$evidence_matrix' input_results/raw_outputs/evidence_matrix.tsv && #end if #if $evidence_summary: cp '$evidence_summary' input_results/raw_outputs/evidence_summary.tsv && #end if #if $allele_resolution: cp '$allele_resolution' input_results/raw_outputs/allele_resolution.tsv && #end if #if $ref_fasta: cp '$ref_fasta' input_results/raw_outputs/ref.fasta && #end if #if $query_fasta: cp '$query_fasta' input_results/raw_outputs/query.fasta && #end if mkdir -p output_dir && GeneFior-gene-stats -i input_results -o output_dir #if $genes: -g '$genes' #end if #if $all_genes: --all-genes #end if #if str($gene_selection) != 'None': --gene-selection '$gene_selection' #end if #if $databases: --databases #echo ' '.join($databases)# #end if #if $tools: --tools #echo ' '.join($tools)# #end if #if $ref_fasta: --ref-fasta input_results/raw_outputs/ref.fasta #end if #if $query_fasta: --query-fasta input_results/raw_outputs/query.fasta #end if #if $plot_per_tool: --plot-per-tool #end if #if $report_read_names: --report-read-names #end if #if $report_fasta: --report-fasta #end if #if str($read_selection) != 'None': --read-selection '$read_selection' #end if && cd output_dir && find . -name '*.png' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../plot.png || true && find . -name '*_read_names.txt' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../read_names.txt 2>/dev/null || true && find . -name '*_reads.fasta' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../read_fasta.fasta 2>/dev/null || true && cd .. && zip -r results_archive.zip output_dir

param.name: detection_matrix
param.label: Detection matrix from prior run
param.help: The *_detection_matrix.tsv file from a GeneFíor or AMRfior run

param.name: genes
param.label: Gene names
param.help: Comma-separated gene names or path to a file with gene names

param.name: all_genes
param.label: Include all genes
param.help: Generate stats for all genes in the results

param.name: query_fasta
param.label: Query FASTA
param.help: Original query sequences for FASTA export

param.name: plot_per_tool
param.label: Plot per tool
param.help: Generate separate plots for each tool
